description: This file contains utility functions for printing and formatting test output, specifically for use with Jest matcher utils. It includes functions for printing substrings, array items, constructor names, and differences with color coding, tailored for test result display.

methods.name: printSubstring
methods.description: Formats a string by escaping double quotes and backslashes for safe display.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedSubstring
methods.description: Formats a received string highlighting an expected substring based on start position and length.

methods.name: printReceivedStringContainExpectedResult
methods.description: Formats a received string based on a RegExp match result, highlighting the matched substring.

methods.name: printReceivedArrayContainExpectedItem
methods.description: Formats an array of received items, highlighting a specific item by index.

methods.name: printCloseTo
methods.description: Formats a message comparing received and expected differences with specified precision and color coding.

methods.name: printExpectedConstructorName
methods.description: Formats the expected constructor name with label.

methods.name: printExpectedConstructorNameNot
methods.description: Formats the expected constructor name with label, indicating negation.

methods.name: printReceivedConstructorName
methods.description: Formats the received constructor name with label.

methods.name: printReceivedConstructorNameNot
methods.description: Formats the received constructor name with label, indicating negation and extension.

methods.name: printConstructorName
methods.description: Helper function to format constructor name with label, negation, and expected status.
